pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark, polygonal patches with high-contrast, sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Geometry varies from irregular quadrilaterals to complex polygons with both rounded and acute-angle vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit trivalent or tetravalent connectivity with relatively uniform pixel thickness across the mid-flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of approximately ten avian subjects perched along the dorsal ridge and lower flank, partially obscuring the mane profile and skin texture in localized regions.
